messages:
Ravi P: FYI GreenHarbor (gh-007) just escalated — they got a surprise invoice 3x expected after running a small pilot. renewal discussion in 21 days, execs upset.
Helena S: ouch. is that real usage or a billing calc error?
Ravi P: looks like spike from background replays that were run during onboarding; they assumed replays were sandboxed. tickets show `replay_job` ran against production streams.
Marco V: we can do immediate remediation: 1) issue a one-time goodwill credit equal to the unexpected charge, 2) enable `billing_protect=true` to cap billable tokens/events for 30 days, 3) schedule a 30-min billing + ops review with their finance lead.
Tess L: agree. also add a short script for CSMs to explain: honest apology, credit, safe cap while we investigate, timeline for permanent fix.
Ravi P: engineering — can you toggle a per-customer cap and surface the current 24h usage to the account? keep audit.
Marco V: yes — adding flag now: `POST /internal/customers/gh-007/flags -d '{"billing_protect":true, "cap_amount_cents":50000, "ttl_hours":720}'` will set a $500 cap for 30 days. I'll attach audit_id.
CS Ops Bot: [action created] #ticket-10022 assigned to Tess L — "GreenHarbor billing discrepancy: credit + protective cap". Due: 2027-08-01
Helena S: scheduling the finance review for Thu 11am PT. invite includes: invoice breakdown, replay job ids, and a short remediation timeline.
Tess L: I've added proposed downgrade bullets to ticket-10022 for CSMs: - prorated downgrade to Starter for first billing cycle - keep exports & read-only access for 120 days - provide a 60-day return credit at 40% if they re-up.
Ravi P: also add a small product ask: sandbox replay should default to non-billable unless explicitly opted-in. filing tech debt ticket.
Marco V: flag active, audit_id=aud-2f4b. monitor shows zero further chargeable activity after cap.
Helena S: during the review we'll ask 3 quick feedback items to capture root cause and trust signals: 1) were expectations on replay billing clear? 2) what would rebuild trust (docs, credits, SOW)? 3) sensitivity to price vs SLA? paste answers here after the call.
Tess L: will collect post-call notes and paste them. also adding the CSM neutral script in ticket for consistency.
CS Ops Bot: [ticket-10022] status updated -> in-progress (Tess L).
